defmodule TinyTasks do
  alias TinyTasks.Store

  def add(title) do
    tasks = Store.read()
    id = tasks |> Enum.map(& &1.id) |> Enum.max(fn -> 0 end) |> Kernel.+(1)
    task = %{id: id, status: "open", title: title}

    Store.write(tasks ++ [task])
    task
  end

  def list do
    Store.read()
  end

  def complete(id) do
    tasks = Store.read()

    case Enum.find_index(tasks, &(&1.id == id)) do
      nil ->
        {:error, :not_found}

      index ->
        updated = List.update_at(tasks, index, &%{&1 | status: "done"})
        Store.write(updated)
        {:ok, Enum.at(updated, index)}
    end
  end
end

defmodule Mix.Tasks.Todo.Complete do
  use Mix.Task

  @shortdoc "Complete a task"

  @impl Mix.Task
  def run([id]) do
    Mix.Task.run("app.start")

    case TinyTasks.complete(String.to_integer(id)) do
      {:ok, task} -> Mix.shell().info("Completed task #{task.id}.")
      {:error, :not_found} -> Mix.raise("Unknown task ID: #{id}")
    end
  end
end
